steps.caption: Open Signals from the sidebar, under Work.
The header counts open signals and how many to act on now.
Sources shows where signals come from. Scan now checks your own records — leases, occupancy, availability — for new signals.
Next 12 months: each dot is a dated event, coloured by category. Click a dot to open it.
Views on the left: All, High priority, Expansion, Restructuring, Lease events, Commercial, Leadership, Infrastructure, Unverified, Dismissed & snoozed. The number is how many are open.
Each card: category and type, the company, place, priority, evidence strength bars and status.
Search finds a company, a place or words in the evidence.
Open Filters for the full set.
Company, industry, micro-market, category and type, and the source.
Event dates, detected dates and freshness — for example evidence from the last 30 days.
Confidence (strong, moderate, weak), urgency (act now, this month, watch), status and who it is assigned to.
Sort by priority, newest detected or soonest event. Apply filters.
The badge shows how many filters are on; Clear removes them. The link can be shared — the filters are in the address.
At the bottom: the bars show evidence strength, and the colour key for categories.
